state.rules:
- Rule 1 (Safe Mode Transition): Reaction Wheel Desaturation Failure or Unresolved Attitude Drift > 5.0 Degrees forces immediate Transition to Safe Mode (Code: SAFE_MODE_ACTIVE) to align solar arrays toward the Sun.
- Rule 2 (Thruster Duty Cycle Throttle): Main Hydrazine Thruster Chamber Temperature exceeding 280°C forces automated 50% Throttle Reduction to protect engine nozzle geometry.
- Rule 3 (High Gain Antenna Slewing): Loss of Ka-Band Signal Lock (> 12 dB drop) initiates Automated Antenna Slewing to re-acquire Earth Ground Station telemetry.
- Rule 4 (Low Power Load Shedding): Battery Depth of Discharge (DoD) exceeding 65% forces Non-Essential Payload Shutdown, provided no higher-priority Safe Mode event is active.
- Rule 5 (Nominal Orbit Operations): Science Data Acquisition and High-Rate Downlink proceed normally when all bus telemetry parameters remain within nominal envelopes.
